name: Sample Plan
summary: Minimal format example. Adapt exercises and loads before training.

exercises.feel: Working muscles should feel effort; sharp pain is a reason to stop.
steps: Adjust the seat and safety stops.
Keep the pelvis supported and stop for pain.
exercises.tip: Choose a manageable starting load. Increase by the smallest available step only after all prescribed sets reach the upper rep target with controlled technique and 1–2 repetitions in reserve. Record equipment and loading conventions consistently.
